content: OKF v0.1 (Google Cloud, 2026-06): knowledge = directory of Markdown files w/ YAML frontmatter; only 'type' required, recommended title/description/resource/tags/timestamp; free extension fields. One concept per file (a 'tree' = dir + primary md + assets; 'forest'=bundle). Reserved index.md (progressive nav) + log.md (ISO-8601 change chronicle, any dir level); okf_version in root index.md frontmatter. Cross-links = plain Markdown links => dir is a queryable graph. Apache 2.0, no runtime/SDK. Critique (Marc Bara): only container standardized, no registered type vocab, no link typing, no trust/provenance/retrieval => 'shared storage not shared understanding'. v0.2 plans trust/provenance.
